interpretation.incremental_discrimination_statement: The D+2 Asp motif-only baseline classifies all 25/25 controls, and that motif also determines the fixed-core atom count and net charge. Therefore this panel cannot support any claim that DFT adds discrimination beyond the motif/charge confound, even if every preregistered calibration gate passes.
interpretation.motif_only_rule: predict La iff catalytic-Asp+2 is acidic Asp
